summary: HDFC Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K on September 2, 2026, disclosing that SES ESG Research Private Limited assigned the bank an ESG rating of 74.4 on August 30, 2026. The bank clarifies it did not engage SES for the rating, which was prepared independently from public information. This is routine disclosure of a third-party rating, not a special situation. No deal terms, transactions, or corporate events are involved. This filing is informational only, with no impact on shareholders or trading. Watch for any future regulatory or market response, but no risk-arb angle exists.
